name: École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL)
header:
École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne
(EPFL)
Switzerland · MSc Mathematics (90 ECTS); Mathematics doctorate (EDMA)
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• New for 2027: March MSc applications do not qualify for Excellence funding.
• MSc letters have one-week grace; EDMA letters do not.
• Three MSc referees requested even though processing can begin with two; EDMA requires all three.
• MSc Excellence is not tuition-waiving full-cost support. For Mathematics its normal coverage is three
semesters, not four.
• Do not equate preliminary EDMA admission with a salaried position.
• Relevant shortlist excludes primarily unrelated analysis/topology faculty; emeritus/host appointments are not
assumed to be available primary advisers.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
MSc: UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can be considered with excellent records; prerequisites may be added.
EDMA normally requires master’s/equivalent. Central FAQ permits four/five-year bachelor’s applicants who
explain preparation; EDMA’s exception mentions excellent four-year bachelor’s from other mathematically
intensive domains. Whether a UChicago math BA qualifies directly is not unambiguously established - seek
EDMA equivalence advice; MSc is the straightforward route. Same/similar-field master’s holders cannot apply
for another MSc; Excellence excludes existing master’s holders. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: choose one programme per academic year, scan documents, arrange three professors, select Excellence
checkbox, pay and validate online. Visa-needing applicants should use December window. EDMA: study
groups/openings, choose relevant prospective advisers and obtain three writers; final enrolment needs a
supervisor, topic and secured funding. No account or application was created for this research. [s2] [s3] [s7] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
EDMA ultimately requires adviser acceptance and funding; committee can forward qualified applications to
relevant faculty. Contact the research group to establish suitability/position availability. MSc admission does
not require pre-arranged thesis adviser. Faculty below grouped by relevant work; emeritus/host status flagged.
[s7] [s8] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Only one MSc programme/application per academic year; all MSc evidence electronically uploaded, no
mail/email/fax substitutes. Validating creates applicant number/confirmation and referee invitations. EDMA
edits after validation require administrator devalidation; once in processing, administrator may upload
replacement documents. Revalidate after changes; referee details stay locked. Night maintenance 01:00-03:00
GMT+1 can block doctoral portal. [s3] [s9]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
2027 Excellence change explicitly published. MSc/EDMA admission dates otherwise standing annual rules with

no 2027 clock/timezone; September matriculation logistics still show 2026. Doctoral salary table is 2026. [s4]
[s7] [s11] [s13]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing MSc windows: mid-November-15 December and 16 December-31 March, autumn start only; exact
year/clock/timezone not shown in application page. For 2027 entry, Excellence explicitly requires the first
window (December 15, i.e. December 2026 by cycle inference). EDMA standing cutoffs: 1 December, 15 April,
15 September; no cycle-specific clock/timezone published. Complete letters by chosen EDMA cutoff. [s2] [s3] [s4]
[s7]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
2027 MSc Excellence: December 15 first application window, payment and validation required; later admission
applications are ineligible. Internal EPFL January 31 route does not apply to a UChicago graduate. EDMA
funding follows adviser/grant availability; no separate universal deadline found beyond admission rounds. [s4]
[s5] [s7]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
MSc/Excellence external applicants: one week after the chosen application deadline; confirmation email
specifies exact date. Calendar arithmetic gives December 22/April 7, but portal email is authoritative and
clock/timezone unverified. EDMA: all three recommendations due by the same programme deadline, no
master’s one-week grace. [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
MSc optional scores belong in the complete online file by its deadline; no independent late-score promise
found. EDMA recommended certificates should accompany completed application by chosen round; later
acceptance is unverified. [s3] [s7]
Supporting documents [Conflict]
Complete applicant-uploaded files by application deadline. MSc standing final qualification evidence no later
than September 30, but foreign-degree matriculation requires complete final transcript/degree evidence
BEFORE matriculation; follow earlier offer-specific requirement. Published in-person matriculation dates are
September 1-3, 2026 only, not 2027. PhD qualifying degree must be completed before arrival. [s3] [s9] [s13]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
MSc/Excellence acceptance deadline is specified in Registrar’s email; no universal date established. Fellowship
lost if admission deferred, and MSc admission only valid for that intake. Doctoral preliminary admission
generally permits final registration within one year, subject to supervisor/funding; actual offer/start timing
agreed individually. [s2] [s6] [s8]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc mathematics is taught in English with some optional French; EPFL recommends C1 in teaching language,
but language test certificates are optional. EDMA encourages TOEFL if native language neither English nor
French; no mandatory minimum score found. French is not necessary to begin PhD. [s1] [s3] [s7] [s9] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
MSc has no mandatory language-test certificate to waive. EDMA recommendation is based on native language,
not solely English-medium degree; no explicit UChicago/US-degree waiver of that recommendation found.
Explain English-medium undergraduate study and confirm whether EDMA wants a test; do not call it required.
[s3] [s7] [s9]

GRE General [Standing rule]
MSc GRE optional, welcomed, and explicitly has no influence on Excellence scholarship evaluation. EDMA
checklist highly recommends GRE and central FAQ identifies General GRE as recommended, not required. Code
3253, no department code; notify programme if sending official results. [s3] [s6] [s7] [s9]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No distinct Mathematics Subject GRE requirement established. EDMA says GRE without specifying subject;
central FAQ clarifies General GRE. Ask EDMA whether a Math Subject result is useful before interpreting
generic recommendation as a subject-test requirement. MSc optional GRE upload is allowed but
subject-specific preference unverified. [s3] [s7] [s9]

sections.text:

may be English/French/German/Italian, otherwise legalized translation. EDMA bachelor’s and master’s

just course completion. [s3] [s7] [s8] [s13]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
MSc: enter three academic professor referees familiar with work; at least two received letters needed for
processing, but three requested. Swiss-degree exemptions do not cover UChicago. EDMA: three confidential
recommendations, each questionnaire plus letter, all required for complete file. [s3] [s8]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
External MSc Excellence uses ordinary MSc file and references with no extra document or writer. The two
separately emailed references and January deadline on same page apply to internal EPFL applicants, not John.
No distinct general EDMA funding reference requirement found. [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
MSc and EDMA invitations are generated only when applicant validates/submits the application, not just by
entering names. Submit early enough for writers to act before their respective deadlines. [s3] [s8]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, automated invitations follow final validation. MSc applicant must also pay for valid submission. Writers
submit confidential recommendations directly online; applicant-supplied letters do not substitute. [s3] [s8]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
MSc applicant receives an email after each recommendation. EDMA portal colours: black means two of three
references; blue means all three complete; green means submitted pending completion. These status changes
need not coincide with a deadline. [s3] [s9]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
EDMA referee details cannot be changed after validation, even when application is devalidated for editing;
same details used for one year. This is not an explicit promise that letters can be rewritten/reused
automatically. MSc letter replacement/reuse rules not publicly established; ask before resubmission. [s9]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required for both routes. EDMA upload unprotected PDF ≤2 MB; no public word/page limit. MSc CV upload
required but detailed size/font/page restrictions not specified publicly. [s3] [s7]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
MSc required SOP ≤1,000 words; faithful paraphrase: academic background, career strategy and precise
objectives for EPFL study. Upload within application; font/spacing/page limit unverified. EDMA required
objectives statement, unprotected PDF ≤2 MB; exact word/page limit not published on EDMA page (do not
import EDIC computer-science two-page rule). [s3] [s7]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal-background/diversity essay listed for mathematics MSc/EDMA; do not assume an optional
upload category. [s3] [s7]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
EDMA objectives should identify research specialization and intended supervisors; central selection considers
both. Bachelor’s-only applicant should explain depth/structure of education. Separate research-interest essay
not listed. MSc interests can be addressed in SOP. [s8] [s9] [s3]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No standalone formal research proposal listed for MSc or EDMA; doctoral objectives and eventual agreed thesis
topic are distinct. Public checklist does not establish permission for a separate long proposal. [s7] [s8]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
MSc explicitly welcomes optional research publications/portfolios, uploaded in application only; no compulsory
thesis/sample. Limits and whether a link alone is adequate unverified. EDMA separate writing sample not
publicly required; optional paper permissions not specified. [s3] [s7]
Publications list [Unresolved]
MSc optional publications uploads welcome; separate list not mandatory. EDMA publication list can be relevant
within CV/objectives but no separate prescribed document or limit found. Do not mail unsolicited papers. [s3]
[s7]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list or course descriptions required in public MSc/EDMA checklist.
Transcript/course history supports preparation; EDMA bachelor’s exception should be explained in objectives.
Dedicated template/extra-upload limits unverified. [s3] [s7] [s9]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
External MSc Excellence: checkbox plus same MSc documents, no separate essay. Selection includes academic
achievement and broader research/extracurricular accomplishments. Internal EPFL motivation-letter procedure
does not apply. Other named external funding may have its own forms, which are not universally required for
EDMA. [s4] [s5]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Passport/official ID required. EDMA includes scientific interests in application; exact live text-field lengths
unverified. For conditional bachelor’s equivalence include preparation explanation in objectives, not invented
course-form requirement. [s7] [s8] [s9]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
MSc Excellence CHF 10,000 per semester (arithmetic CHF 20,000 for two semesters), paid each semester;
student pays tuition, rent and insurance from it. Mathematics is 90 ECTS, normally max three funded
semesters. Room reservation is offered, not free housing. Doctoral assistant 2026 gross salary CHF 55,225
year 1, 56,225 year 2, 57,225 year 3, 58,225 years 4-6, including thirteenth salary month; 2027 rate not yet
established. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s10] [s11]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc 90-ECTS fellowship max three semesters including project; renewal after first year needs conditions below.
Doctoral employment duration is contract/adviser-specific, not established as a universal six-year guarantee
merely because salary table lists six years. [s1] [s6] [s11]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
MSc Excellence explicitly open internationally and external graduates may receive room reservation. Doctoral
assistant employment/funding is available to foreign applicants subject to admission/work permission; external
home-country scholarships must be supplemented to institutional income-equivalent level under policy. US F-1
does not establish Swiss permit or fee status. [s5] [s6] [s8] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
MSc renewal: weighted average ≥5.0/6 and ≥50 eligible ECTS in first year, without exceptions under published
rule; qualifying courses exclude language/admission/outside-plan credits. Declare other scholarships;
substantial simultaneous awards restricted/case-by-case. PhD assistant duties include research,
undergraduate teaching and unit service; salary increments depend on resources/economic conditions.
Preliminary academic acceptance alone can be unfunded. [s5] [s6] [s10] [s11]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
MSc Excellence checkbox must accompany paid/validated December application; no extra documents for
external candidates. EDMA needs programme admission plus a funded adviser position; check advertised
positions and contact relevant groups. Formal hiring follows admission and may require about three months for
visa/work administration. [s5] [s7] [s8] [s20]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
EPFL social aid for international students generally only after at least one successful year at EPFL, for
unexpected hardship after other resources exhausted; it is not first-year financial planning. Tuition-transition
allowance is restricted to EPFL bachelor’s graduates, so not a UChicago route. Home-country/external
doctorate awards possible. MSc budget page estimates roughly CHF 29,000 annual living costs plus tuition
(foreign-specific table about CHF 25,219); budget varies and scholarship does not promise full costs. [s10] [s16]
[s17]
Application fee [Standing rule]
MSc application CHF 150 for foreign bachelor’s, non-refundable; card/PayPal/Twint, paid before validation.
Doctoral application free; foreign-degree doctoral registration CHF 150 and completion tax CHF 1,500 are
separate. Current MSc semester invoice normally CHF 2,240 for foreign students relocating for study (CHF
2,190 tuition + CHF 50 charges), with nationality/residence exceptions; confirm individual classification. [s3] [s9]
[s15] [s18]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No UChicago/international financial-hardship application-fee waiver found in official admissions/FAQ searches.
Published zero/lower MSc fees are specific EPFL/Swiss-degree exceptions, not a general waiver. Doctoral
application is already free. [s3] [s9]

Switzerland · MSc Mathematics (90 ECTS); Mathematics doctorate (EDMA)
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• New for 2027: March MSc applications do not qualify for Excellence funding.
• MSc letters have one-week grace; EDMA letters do not.
• Three MSc referees requested even though processing can begin with two; EDMA requires all three.
• MSc Excellence is not tuition-waiving full-cost support. For Mathematics its normal coverage is three
semesters, not four.
• Do not equate preliminary EDMA admission with a salaried position.
• Relevant shortlist excludes primarily unrelated analysis/topology faculty; emeritus/host appointments are not
assumed to be available primary advisers.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
MSc: UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can be considered with excellent records; prerequisites may be added.
EDMA normally requires master’s/equivalent. Central FAQ permits four/five-year bachelor’s applicants who
explain preparation; EDMA’s exception mentions excellent four-year bachelor’s from other mathematically
intensive domains. Whether a UChicago math BA qualifies directly is not unambiguously established - seek
EDMA equivalence advice; MSc is the straightforward route. Same/similar-field master’s holders cannot apply
for another MSc; Excellence excludes existing master’s holders. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: choose one programme per academic year, scan documents, arrange three professors, select Excellence
checkbox, pay and validate online. Visa-needing applicants should use December window. EDMA: study
groups/openings, choose relevant prospective advisers and obtain three writers; final enrolment needs a
supervisor, topic and secured funding. No account or application was created for this research. [s2] [s3] [s7] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
EDMA ultimately requires adviser acceptance and funding; committee can forward qualified applications to
relevant faculty. Contact the research group to establish suitability/position availability. MSc admission does
not require pre-arranged thesis adviser. Faculty below grouped by relevant work; emeritus/host status flagged.
[s7] [s8] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Only one MSc programme/application per academic year; all MSc evidence electronically uploaded, no
mail/email/fax substitutes. Validating creates applicant number/confirmation and referee invitations. EDMA
edits after validation require administrator devalidation; once in processing, administrator may upload
replacement documents. Revalidate after changes; referee details stay locked. Night maintenance 01:00-03:00
GMT+1 can block doctoral portal. [s3] [s9]

Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing MSc windows: mid-November-15 December and 16 December-31 March, autumn start only; exact

Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
2027 MSc Excellence: December 15 first application window, payment and validation required; later admission
applications are ineligible. Internal EPFL January 31 route does not apply to a UChicago graduate. EDMA
funding follows adviser/grant availability; no separate universal deadline found beyond admission rounds. [s4]

Reference receipt [Standing rule]
MSc/Excellence external applicants: one week after the chosen application deadline; confirmation email
specifies exact date. Calendar arithmetic gives December 22/April 7, but portal email is authoritative and
clock/timezone unverified. EDMA: all three recommendations due by the same programme deadline, no
master’s one-week grace. [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8]

MSc optional scores belong in the complete online file by its deadline; no independent late-score promise
found. EDMA recommended certificates should accompany completed application by chosen round; later
acceptance is unverified. [s3] [s7]
Supporting documents [Conflict]
Complete applicant-uploaded files by application deadline. MSc standing final qualification evidence no later
than September 30, but foreign-degree matriculation requires complete final transcript/degree evidence
BEFORE matriculation; follow earlier offer-specific requirement. Published in-person matriculation dates are
September 1-3, 2026 only, not 2027. PhD qualifying degree must be completed before arrival. [s3] [s9] [s13]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
MSc/Excellence acceptance deadline is specified in Registrar’s email; no universal date established. Fellowship
lost if admission deferred, and MSc admission only valid for that intake. Doctoral preliminary admission
generally permits final registration within one year, subject to supervisor/funding; actual offer/start timing
agreed individually. [s2] [s6] [s8]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc mathematics is taught in English with some optional French; EPFL recommends C1 in teaching language,
but language test certificates are optional. EDMA encourages TOEFL if native language neither English nor
French; no mandatory minimum score found. French is not necessary to begin PhD. [s1] [s3] [s7] [s9] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
MSc has no mandatory language-test certificate to waive. EDMA recommendation is based on native language,
not solely English-medium degree; no explicit UChicago/US-degree waiver of that recommendation found.
Explain English-medium undergraduate study and confirm whether EDMA wants a test; do not call it required.

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc uploads complete transcripts from every university, degrees if already available, passport/ID; documents
may be English/French/German/Italian, otherwise legalized translation. EDMA bachelor’s and master’s
diplomas/grades or official attestation, with certified translations outside these languages. Doctoral central
page covers all higher-education institutions. Later MSc records must be authenticatable and attest award, not
just course completion. [s3] [s7] [s8] [s13]

Transcript/course history supports preparation; EDMA bachelor’s exception should be explained in objectives.
Dedicated template/extra-upload limits unverified. [s3] [s7] [s9]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
MSc: enter three academic professor referees familiar with work; at least two received letters needed for
processing, but three requested. Swiss-degree exemptions do not cover UChicago. EDMA: three confidential
recommendations, each questionnaire plus letter, all required for complete file. [s3] [s8]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
External MSc Excellence uses ordinary MSc file and references with no extra document or writer. The two
separately emailed references and January deadline on same page apply to internal EPFL applicants, not John.
No distinct general EDMA funding reference requirement found. [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
MSc and EDMA invitations are generated only when applicant validates/submits the application, not just by
entering names. Submit early enough for writers to act before their respective deadlines. [s3] [s8]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, automated invitations follow final validation. MSc applicant must also pay for valid submission. Writers
submit confidential recommendations directly online; applicant-supplied letters do not substitute. [s3] [s8]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
MSc applicant receives an email after each recommendation. EDMA portal colours: black means two of three
references; blue means all three complete; green means submitted pending completion. These status changes
need not coincide with a deadline. [s3] [s9]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
EDMA referee details cannot be changed after validation, even when application is devalidated for editing;
same details used for one year. This is not an explicit promise that letters can be rewritten/reused
automatically. MSc letter replacement/reuse rules not publicly established; ask before resubmission. [s9]

Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written

Pay attention to
• New for 2027: March MSc applications do not qualify for Excellence funding.
• MSc letters have one-week grace; EDMA letters do not.
• Three MSc referees requested even though processing can begin with two; EDMA requires all three.
• MSc Excellence is not tuition-waiving full-cost support. For Mathematics its normal coverage is three
semesters, not four.
• Do not equate preliminary EDMA admission with a salaried position.
• Relevant shortlist excludes primarily unrelated analysis/topology faculty; emeritus/host appointments are not
assumed to be available primary advisers.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
MSc: UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can be considered with excellent records; prerequisites may be added.
EDMA normally requires master’s/equivalent. Central FAQ permits four/five-year bachelor’s applicants who
explain preparation; EDMA’s exception mentions excellent four-year bachelor’s from other mathematically
intensive domains. Whether a UChicago math BA qualifies directly is not unambiguously established - seek
EDMA equivalence advice; MSc is the straightforward route. Same/similar-field master’s holders cannot apply
for another MSc; Excellence excludes existing master’s holders. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: choose one programme per academic year, scan documents, arrange three professors, select Excellence
checkbox, pay and validate online. Visa-needing applicants should use December window. EDMA: study
groups/openings, choose relevant prospective advisers and obtain three writers; final enrolment needs a
supervisor, topic and secured funding. No account or application was created for this research. [s2] [s3] [s7] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
EDMA ultimately requires adviser acceptance and funding; committee can forward qualified applications to
relevant faculty. Contact the research group to establish suitability/position availability. MSc admission does
not require pre-arranged thesis adviser. Faculty below grouped by relevant work; emeritus/host status flagged.
[s7] [s8] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Only one MSc programme/application per academic year; all MSc evidence electronically uploaded, no
mail/email/fax substitutes. Validating creates applicant number/confirmation and referee invitations. EDMA
edits after validation require administrator devalidation; once in processing, administrator may upload
replacement documents. Revalidate after changes; referee details stay locked. Night maintenance 01:00-03:00
GMT+1 can block doctoral portal. [s3] [s9]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
2027 Excellence change explicitly published. MSc/EDMA admission dates otherwise standing annual rules with

no 2027 clock/timezone; September matriculation logistics still show 2026. Doctoral salary table is 2026. [s4]
[s7] [s11] [s13]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing MSc windows: mid-November-15 December and 16 December-31 March, autumn start only; exact
year/clock/timezone not shown in application page. For 2027 entry, Excellence explicitly requires the first
window (December 15, i.e. December 2026 by cycle inference). EDMA standing cutoffs: 1 December, 15 April,
15 September; no cycle-specific clock/timezone published. Complete letters by chosen EDMA cutoff. [s2] [s3] [s4]
[s7]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
2027 MSc Excellence: December 15 first application window, payment and validation required; later admission
applications are ineligible. Internal EPFL January 31 route does not apply to a UChicago graduate. EDMA
funding follows adviser/grant availability; no separate universal deadline found beyond admission rounds. [s4]
[s5] [s7]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
MSc/Excellence external applicants: one week after the chosen application deadline; confirmation email
specifies exact date. Calendar arithmetic gives December 22/April 7, but portal email is authoritative and
clock/timezone unverified. EDMA: all three recommendations due by the same programme deadline, no
master’s one-week grace. [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
MSc optional scores belong in the complete online file by its deadline; no independent late-score promise
found. EDMA recommended certificates should accompany completed application by chosen round; later
acceptance is unverified. [s3] [s7]
Supporting documents [Conflict]
Complete applicant-uploaded files by application deadline. MSc standing final qualification evidence no later
than September 30, but foreign-degree matriculation requires complete final transcript/degree evidence
BEFORE matriculation; follow earlier offer-specific requirement. Published in-person matriculation dates are
September 1-3, 2026 only, not 2027. PhD qualifying degree must be completed before arrival. [s3] [s9] [s13]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
MSc/Excellence acceptance deadline is specified in Registrar’s email; no universal date established. Fellowship
lost if admission deferred, and MSc admission only valid for that intake. Doctoral preliminary admission
generally permits final registration within one year, subject to supervisor/funding; actual offer/start timing
agreed individually. [s2] [s6] [s8]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc mathematics is taught in English with some optional French; EPFL recommends C1 in teaching language,
but language test certificates are optional. EDMA encourages TOEFL if native language neither English nor
French; no mandatory minimum score found. French is not necessary to begin PhD. [s1] [s3] [s7] [s9] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
MSc has no mandatory language-test certificate to waive. EDMA recommendation is based on native language,
not solely English-medium degree; no explicit UChicago/US-degree waiver of that recommendation found.
Explain English-medium undergraduate study and confirm whether EDMA wants a test; do not call it required.
[s3] [s7] [s9]

GRE General [Standing rule]
MSc GRE optional, welcomed, and explicitly has no influence on Excellence scholarship evaluation. EDMA
checklist highly recommends GRE and central FAQ identifies General GRE as recommended, not required. Code
3253, no department code; notify programme if sending official results. [s3] [s6] [s7] [s9]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No distinct Mathematics Subject GRE requirement established. EDMA says GRE without specifying subject;
central FAQ clarifies General GRE. Ask EDMA whether a Math Subject result is useful before interpreting
generic recommendation as a subject-test requirement. MSc optional GRE upload is allowed but
subject-specific preference unverified. [s3] [s7] [s9]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc uploads complete transcripts from every university, degrees if already available, passport/ID; documents
may be English/French/German/Italian, otherwise legalized translation. EDMA bachelor’s and master’s
diplomas/grades or official attestation, with certified translations outside these languages. Doctoral central
page covers all higher-education institutions. Later MSc records must be authenticatable and attest award, not
just course completion. [s3] [s7] [s8] [s13]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]

Transcript/course history supports preparation; EDMA bachelor’s exception should be explained in objectives.
Dedicated template/extra-upload limits unverified. [s3] [s7] [s9]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
MSc: enter three academic professor referees familiar with work; at least two received letters needed for
processing, but three requested. Swiss-degree exemptions do not cover UChicago. EDMA: three confidential
recommendations, each questionnaire plus letter, all required for complete file. [s3] [s8]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
External MSc Excellence uses ordinary MSc file and references with no extra document or writer. The two
separately emailed references and January deadline on same page apply to internal EPFL applicants, not John.
No distinct general EDMA funding reference requirement found. [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]

entering names. Submit early enough for writers to act before their respective deadlines. [s3] [s8]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, automated invitations follow final validation. MSc applicant must also pay for valid submission. Writers
submit confidential recommendations directly online; applicant-supplied letters do not substitute. [s3] [s8]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]

references; blue means all three complete; green means submitted pending completion. These status changes
